mapper.sql: c.ICATE_NO, c.SGUBUN_ID, c.SNAME, c.SFULL_NAME, c.ILEVEL, c.IREF, c.IREF_LV_1, c.IREF_LV_2, c.IREF_LV_3, c.IREF_LV_4, c.IREF_LV_5, c.IREF_LV_6, c.IREF_LV_7, c.IREF_LV_8, c.IREF_LV_9, c.IREF_LV_10, c.SDISP_YN, c.SDEL_YN, c.ISEQ, c.SINS_DT, c.SSYS_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT LPAD(' ', 4*(t.LV-1)) || t.SNAME AS INDENT_PATH, t.LV AS TREE_LEVEL, t.ICATE_NO, t.SGUBUN_ID, t.SNAME, t.SFULL_NAME, t.ILEVEL, t.IREF, t.IREF_LV_1, t.IREF_LV_2, t.IREF_LV_3, t.IREF_LV_4, t.IREF_LV_5, t.IREF_LV_6, t.IREF_LV_7, t.IREF_LV_8, t.IREF_LV_9, t.IREF_LV_10, t.SDISP_YN, t.SDEL_YN, t.ISEQ, t.SINS_DT, t.SSYS_ID, NVL(p.PROM_CNT, 0) AS PROM_CNT, NVL(ch.CHILD_CNT, 0) AS CHILD_CNT FROM ( SELECT LEVEL AS LV, c.* FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.SDEL_YN = 'N' START WITH c.IREF = 0 CONNECT BY PRIOR c.ICATE_NO = c.IREF ORDER SIBLINGS BY c.ISEQ, c.ICATE_NO ) t LEFT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT ICATE_NO, COUNT(*) AS PROM_CNT FROM TB_PROM p WHERE SEXISTING_YN = 'Y'
AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y'
GROUP BY ICATE_NO) p ON t.ICATE_NO = p.ICATE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT IREF, COUNT(*) AS CHILD_CNT FROM TB_CATE WHERE SDEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY IREF) ch ON t.ICATE_NO = ch.IREF
SELECT , NULL AS INDENT_PATH, NULL AS TREE_LEVEL, NULL AS PROM_CNT, NULL AS CHILD_CNT FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.IREF = #{parentNo} AND c.SDEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY c.ISEQ, c.ICATE_NO
SELECT , NULL AS INDENT_PATH, NULL AS TREE_LEVEL, NULL AS PROM_CNT, NULL AS CHILD_CNT FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.ICATE_NO = #{cateNo}

SELECT , NULL AS INDENT_PATH, LEVEL AS TREE_LEVEL, NULL AS PROM_CNT, NULL AS CHILD_CNT FROM TB_CATE c WHERE c.SDEL_YN = 'N' START WITH c.IREF = #{cateNo} CONNECT BY PRIOR c.ICATE_NO = c.IREF ORDER SIBLINGS BY c.ISEQ, c.ICATE_NO
SELECT c.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE c START WITH c.ICATE_NO IN #{cn} CONNECT BY PRIOR c.ICATE_NO = c.IREF
SELECT NVL(MAX(ISEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_CATE WHERE IREF = #{parentNo} AND SDEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(V, '[0-9]+$'))), 0) FROM ( SELECT CODE AS V FROM COMTCCMMNDETAILCODE WHERE CODE_ID = 'SGUBUN' AND REGEXP_LIKE(CODE, '^FT_GUBUN_[0-9]+$') UNION ALL SELECT SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_CATE WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(SGUBUN_ID, '^FT_GUBUN_[0-9]+$') UNION ALL SELECT SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_PROM WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(SGUBUN_ID, '^FT_GUBUN_[0-9]+$') )
SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CATE WHERE SGUBUN_ID = #{gubunId} AND NVL(SDEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' ) AS CATE_CNT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROM WHERE SGUBUN_ID = #{gubunId} ) AS PROM_CNT FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CATE ( ICATE_NO, SGUBUN_ID, SNAME, SFULL_NAME, ILEVEL, IREF, IREF_LV_1, IREF_LV_2, IREF_LV_3, IREF_LV_4, IREF_LV_5, IREF_LV_6, IREF_LV_7, IREF_LV_8, IREF_LV_9, IREF_LV_10, SDISP_YN, SDEL_YN, ISEQ, SINS_DT ) VALUES ( #{cateNo}, #{gubunId}, #{cateNm}, #{fullNm}, #{level}, #{ref}, #{refLv1}, #{refLv2}, #{refLv3}, #{refLv4}, #{refLv5}, #{refLv6}, #{refLv7}, #{refLv8}, #{refLv9}, #{refLv10}, #{dispYn}, 'N', #{seq}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CATE SET SGUBUN_ID = #{gubunId}, SNAME = #{cateNm}, SFULL_NAME = #{fullNm}, ILEVEL = #{level}, IREF = #{ref}, IREF_LV_1 = #{refLv1}, IREF_LV_2 = #{refLv2}, IREF_LV_3 = #{refLv3}, IREF_LV_4 = #{refLv4}, IREF_LV_5 = #{refLv5}, IREF_LV_6 = #{refLv6}, IREF_LV_7 = #{refLv7}, IREF_LV_8 = #{refLv8}, IREF_LV_9 = #{refLv9}, IREF_LV_10 = #{refLv10}, SDISP_YN = #{dispYn}, ISEQ = #{seq} WHERE ICATE_NO = #{cateNo}
UPDATE TB_CATE SET SDEL_YN = 'Y' WHERE ICATE_NO = #{cateNo}
